520:t_1:86.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then what are you thinking about?」

520:t_1:88.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do you still love her?」

520:t_1:90.en:
$n
「But... $$マキ#pilot$$ really did help me when I was struggling emotionally.」

520:t_1:91.en:
$n
「Even if $$マキ#pilot$$ approached me on a $$クロノ$$ mission, I won't forget that.」

520:t_1:92.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You're lucky, $n, to be surrounded by $$マキ#pilot$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$.」

520:t_1:93.en:
$n
「I'm grateful to you, too, $$ティティ$$.」

520:t_1:94.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Even if you're just flattering me, hearing you say that makes me happy.」

520:t_1:96.en:
$$クェス$$
「What's wrong, $$ハマーン$$? You look so grim...」

520:t_1:98.en:
$$クェス$$
「Let's not do that. We're comrades fighting together.」

520:t_1:100.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm sorry. That's precisely why there are things I can't tell you.」

520:t_1:101.en:
$$クェス$$
「I understand. ...But don't bear it all alone.」

520:t_1:102.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems I've made you worry. Thank you, $$クェス$$.」

520:t_1:103.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Oh... $$ハマーン$$... Do you know where $$マリーダ$$ is?」

520:t_1:104.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$マリーダ$$ is in the infirmary. She's exhausted and sleeping.」

520:t_1:105.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is... something wrong with her?」

520:t_1:106.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I can't say anything about that.」

520:t_1:107.en:
$$クェス$$
「She'll be all right, $$バナージ$$. $$ナナイ$$ is aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, so she'll examine $$マリーダ$$, too.」

520:t_1:108.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're right... We probably won't have any operations for a while, so $$マリーダ$$ can get plenty of rest.」

520:t_1:109.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We'll reach the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ soon...」

520:t_1:110.en:
$$クェス$$
「Come to think of it, this will be your first time aboard, $$ハマーン$$.」

520:t_1:112.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(What's this unease in my chest...?)

520:t_1:113.en:
$$ハマーン$$
(Is this anxiety... connected to the chill I felt earlier...?)

520:t_2:3.en: ～Deep-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　Dock～

520:t_2:7.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't move, $c. You're completely surrounded.」

520:t_2:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「What does this mean!? What's going on!?」

520:t_2:9.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You still don't understand? $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has already occupied this enormous spacecraft.」

520:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No...! You're saying they broke through all that jamming!?」

520:t_2:11.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What fools you are. Your repeated, reckless actions without thought for the consequences brought this about.」

520:t_2:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why, Captain!? $$マリーダ$$ is in $c, too! And yet...!」

520:t_2:19.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You're embarrassing yourself, $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

520:t_2:23.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That was a warning shot. Next time, I'll shoot you for real.」

520:t_2:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believe I forbade rough treatment, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:29.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is a chance to meet face-to-face with you, with whom I share such deep ties. I couldn't pass it up.」

520:t_2:31.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Naturally, he's accompanying me. Of course, he'll also attend our meeting.」

520:t_2:32.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You want to talk...? Are you trying to show how confident you are?」

520:t_2:33.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ハマーン$$... I have no wish to needlessly lose valuable people, including you.」

520:t_2:34.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's why I want to open my heart and reveal my true intentions to gain your cooperation.」

520:t_2:35.en:
$n
「You must think very little of us.」

520:t_2:36.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Is there another one here who doesn't know how to speak properly?」

520:t_2:37.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Stop, $$アンジェロ$$. Their tempers must be running high right now.」

520:t_2:38.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「First, let them rest after their long journey. The meeting will be in six hours.」

520:t_2:39.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I understand. Until then, I'll detain the members of $c.」

520:t_2:40.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Make sure you treat them courteously.」

520:t_2:42.en:
$$ブライト$$
「For now, we have no choice but to follow their instructions.」

520:t_2:43.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's good. You've finally understood your position.」

520:t_2:44.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アンジェロ$$... You bastard...」

520:t_2:45.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't be so eager, $$ギュネイ$$. I'll give traitors the punishment they deserve later.」

520:t_2:46.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I believe I forbade rough treatment, Captain $$アンジェロ$$.」

520:t_2:50.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is a chance to meet face-to-face with you, with whom I share such deep ties. I couldn't pass it up.」

520:t_2:52.en:

「Naturally, he's accompanying me. Of course, he'll also attend our meeting.」
